evals.prompt: Review a Report screen built with DS components. A 'Pro' tag is styled with a teal fill from a custom property the app defines, and section headings are a deep blue from another custom property. Buttons, links, status and charts are untouched DS components.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.expected_output: C1 FAILs: teal and blue are not palette colours. Fix: use the DS tag and the default ink. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt: Review a sidebar. The active navigation item's label and icon use `var(--aha-logo-purple)`, and a 'New' pill beside it is filled with `var(--aha-vivid-pink-30)`. Everything else is DS components on white.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C2: palette colours outside their roles.
evals.expected_output: C2 FAILs: purple is the logo only, and Vivid Pink at 30% is for charts only. Fix: Vivid Pink or the default ink for the active item, and the DS tag for the pill. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt: Review a selected card. Its background is `var(--aha-bg-accent)` (Vivid Pink at 5%) and the title and a 'Learn more' link inside it are `var(--aha-color-primary)`. Separately, a Vivid Pink banner sets its body text to white at 80% opacity.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C3: text colour against its background.
evals.expected_output: C3 FAILs: pink text on pale pink, and see-through white on Vivid Pink. Fix: the default ink on the pale pink card (set --aha-text-link on the container) and solid white on the banner. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt: Review a delete confirmation modal. 'Delete presentation' is a primary button restyled with a red fill from an app-defined custom property, and 'Cancel' is a secondary button. The body text names what will be lost. No other colour is used.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.expected_output: C4 FAILs: the destructive action is the primary button, and it is red. Fix: Cancel is the primary button; Delete is the DS danger button, which carries no hue. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt: Review a team table. Each row's status is a coloured dot with a label: green for Active, amber for Pending, red for Suspended, set through app-defined custom properties. A trend column shows +12% in green and -4% in red. Backgrounds are white throughout.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C5: hue for status and trend.
evals.expected_output: C5 FAILs: status and trend are shown in green, amber and red. Fix: the DS status badge (icon, wording, outline or black fill); a rise in plain black with an up arrow, a fall as white on a black pill with a down arrow. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt: Review a Report chart built with `<aha-chart>` on an app screen. The author overrides the series colours through its options with six hand-picked colours: Vivid Pink, a teal, an orange, a blue, black and a grey, one per series, with no value labels.

evals.expected_output: C6 FAILs: six series colours, four of them hand-picked hues. Fix: palette="brand"; beyond four series repeat the four with a pattern and label each mark. Overall: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt: Review the Marketplace page, which lists the tools AhaSlides connects to. evals.prompt: Review a Presenter home screen in the product app. The page has one primary 'New presentation' button in Vivid Pink. A paid-only 'Export' menu item carries the DS Paywall upgrade mark, a DS Progress bar shows storage used, the selected sidebar item has a Vivid Pink icon, and a DS Alert holds an inline text-link in Vivid Pink.
